title: IPO bid upload (BSE iBBS) - PROVISIONAL layout
when: Each bidding day, during bidding hours
purpose: Bulk upload of client bids (new, modify, cancel) for a public issue on BSE's iBBS, one line per bid option. PROVISIONAL: correct the columns from BSE notice 20230110-44 Annexure A before the first live upload.

columns.name: activityType
columns.note: N new, M modify, C cancel

columns.name: category
columns.note: iBBS category code (set per issue in Ledgerline)

columns.name: subCategory
columns.note: sub-category code, if the issue has one

columns.name: applicationNumber
columns.note: the platform's application number; blank for a new bid

columns.name: referenceNumber
columns.note: the member's own reference: Ledgerline's bid number

columns.name: upiFlag
columns.note: Y for a UPI bid, N for ASBA through the client's bank account

columns.name: upi
columns.note: the client's own UPI ID (UPI bids)

columns.name: bankAccount
columns.note: the client's own bank account (ASBA bids)

columns.name: clientCode
columns.note: the client's UCC with the member

linked: Written from IPO & public issues (Bids: bid file), one file per issue and exchange
source: PROVISIONAL. BSE notice 20230110-44 of 10 Jan 2023 (Annexure A.xls) publishes the iBBS bid upload and response files, standardised across exchanges with ISO tags (following notice 20220613-44); the annexure was not publicly retrievable. Until it is in hand this layout mirrors Ledgerline's provisional NSE layout, since the formats are common across exchanges. Replace the columns with Annexure A before the first live upload.
